'''"Everybody's Got Something to Sell"''' was a song written in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by a [[Unidentified young new recruit|promising Jedi recruit]]. It was created for the benefit of young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after he left his home and became a [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]]. It was a song about the merchants of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
